title: Full Manifest Audit
description: A dockside audit doesn't take the crew roster's word for it — it counts heads against the ship's log. Register one fresh account per role and reconcile the API's story against the database's.
successCondition: Register 4 new accounts, one per role (admin, dispatcher, driver, customer), each with a unique email. Each POST /api/auth/register returns 201 with the correct role echoed back. Querying users via `npm run db:psql` (select role, count(*) from users where email in (<the 4 new emails>) group by role;) shows exactly 1 row per role for the new emails, and a fifth registration attempt reusing any of the 4 emails with a DIFFERENT role still returns 409 — the email uniqueness constraint doesn't care that the role changed.
hints: role is validated against the Role enum in the request schema (apps/api/src/modules/auth/schema.ts) before it ever reaches Postgres.
Give each account a distinct, throwaway email like audit-admin-<random>@swiftcargo.test so you don't collide with seeded demo accounts.
